objective: Bound evaluator-quorum risk under unknown cross-model dependence using externally published SoundnessBench error marginals.
claim_boundary: The LP gives exact worst-case bounds over joint Bernoulli distributions compatible with published marginals. It does not estimate actual evaluator dependence or assert that the worst case occurs in practice.
next_proof_obligation: Collect or execute per-case heterogeneous evaluator predictions, estimate dependence with uncertainty bounds on calibration data, then evaluate a frozen certificate on locked holdout data.
